objectives.title: Operate an autonomous evidence-driven portfolio intelligence system
objectives.statement: Build a self-triggering portfolio intelligence layer that continuously observes, learns, hunts, experiments, verifies, and improves without requiring interactive ChatGPT for ordinary operation while keeping consequential external authority human-gated.
success_conditions: Ordinary portfolio learning cycles can execute from durable automation without an interactive ChatGPT prompt.
Verified outcomes update durable shared state and future decision policy.
constraints: No autonomous live trading or brokerage execution.
No secrets or private operational/customer payloads stored while this repository is public.
evidence_requirements: Exact source revisions and durable event/evidence receipts.
Deterministic tests plus independent verification for consequential promotion.

objectives.title: Retired commercial micro-product experiment
objectives.statement: Historical record of the former micro-product revenue experiment. Expected future revenue from the prior speculative businesses is treated as zero; no new engineering, research, outreach, marketplace publication, or paid-model budget may be allocated to this objective.
success_conditions: Historical commercial evidence remains preserved without being treated as an active objective.
No scheduler, Hunter, factory, dashboard action, or paid-model allocation creates new speculative commercial work from this objective.
Engineering capacity is routed to verified reliability, autonomy, security, maintainability, and user-requested project improvements instead.
constraints: Expected future revenue from the retired speculative businesses is zero for planning purposes.
Do not generate replacement businesses, SaaS concepts, micro-products, outreach campaigns, or marketplace experiments merely to seek revenue.
Do not delete historical evidence or misstate historical commercial results.
evidence_requirements: Active scheduler and Hunter policies show commercial speculation disabled.
Micro-product factory and revenue-reset policy are retired while retaining historical records.

provenance.source_ref: Owner commercial-retirement and autonomy-first instruction in ChatGPT on 2026-10-01
